_notes: Configured June 2026. AAP runs the SearchSpring Snap theme (ul.ss__results, .ss__pagination__*). Category taxonomy: /fire-rated/, /flush/, /recessed/, etc. (no /products/ umbrella); NOT flat - nested child categories exist (verified live July 2026 via xmlsitemap.php?type=categories), deepest under /specialty/ (2-3 levels, e.g. /specialty/glass-fiber-doors/glass-fiber-reinforced-gypsum-radius-corner/). Category pages DO render server-side subcategory tiles (.subCategoriesBox with span.navList-action title + a.navList-action link) - the June 2026 'no subcategory boxes / flat taxonomy' note was wrong (only /fire-rated/ was inspected). subcategory suite runs against plp.subcategory=/fire-rated/fbr-5060-fire-rated-uninsulated-removable-panel/ (child of /fire-rated/, breadcrumb contains 'Fire-Rated'). No pro-club form (/pro-club-application/ 404s). Qty stepper buttons absent (no data-action inc/dec; bare .form-increment input). Related carousel is SS recommendation (.ss__recommendation--carousel). Footer: bare <footer> with .box h3 headings, div.copyright for copyright text; phone in footer-bottom-col (1 tel: link). Mobile nav is #mySidenav. LIGHTHOUSE (calibrated July 2 2026, live scores homepage a11y 66 / plp 73 / pdp 64): theme structurally below a healthy a11y score, but clears the fleet-wide accessibility:60 floor (no per-store override). Partly tied to the known sub-44px touch-target deficiency (mobile header hamburger 23px / logo 12px, tallest interactive el ~26px). July 22 2026: the AAP dev team reviewed the touch-target gap and chose to keep the header as-is, so the mobile touch-target tests are now SKIPPED in every browser via branding.skipTouchTarget:true (sanctioned team-decision exception to the leave-it-failing policy). Lighthouse best-practices is no longer asserted fleet-wide (dropped July 22 2026 — platform-level, non-actionable; AAP PDP had scored 58). SEPT 29 2026: branding.footerLocationText set to 'New York' — the footer 'Contact us' block reads 'PO Box 4668, PMB 76520, New York, New York 10163-4668 US' (was null). pdp.mobileBreadcrumbsHidden now applies to phones only (the trail is 0x0 at 360/393/412px but renders at the 810px tablet). CHECKOUT (onboarded Sept 30 2026): checkout.product is /16-x-16-universal-flush-access-door-with-hidden-flange-acudor/ (product id 1501, SKU BP1616SCPC, $66.68), priced, in stock, purchasable, 0 attribute[] inputs, adding exactly 1 physical line item. checkout.customFields is [] (GET /api/storefront/form-fields: field_26 / field_28 both required:false). visitQuery redirect=disable is appended by storePath() to the PDP and /checkout visits (not to /api/ requests); /checkout behaves the same with and without it. activeStepClass is checkout-step--current (the BESTCA/ADAP/CAD/FSE build, confirmed by dumping every step className at each stage). AAP’s /checkout carries the same showTime2()/stopFunction2 card-icon script as ADAP and FSE, but ALREADY FIXED: stopFunction2 calls clearInterval(myVar2), with the recursive call commented out (line 602) — the reference fix for ADAP’s and FSE’s devs. No inline saved-address handler, so suppressAddressSwitchInlineErrors stays false. 6 gateways (Stripe Checkout Session, PayPal, PayPal Credit, Venmo, Google Pay, Amazon Pay) render under the store-credit overlay. PRICING: the QA group zeroes the product; subtotal 0 + shipping 26.95 + tax 0 = 26.95, covered by auto-applied store credit. ‘Save this address’ ships CHECKED; the address book held 4 across three runs.
